messages:
sasha-sales: AM standup for Mapspring pilot — quick status. Did: ran scoping call w/ Mapspring, shared dataflow + PII matrix, sent initial estimate for Dedicated capacity. Blocker: customer asked for BYOK + HSM certs for on-prem pilot; they want timeline this week. Also clarifying network peering and IP allowlist. Today: need eng help on on-prem packaging + a short call to align HSM integration plan. pinging @ben-eng and @lina-se for availability.

ben-eng: saw this — fyi we have a private package we recently tested. We should confirm whether Mapspring needs PKCS#11 or a KMS API bridge. Can you share their HSM vendor? Also will need firewall/IP ranges. I can draft a setup checklist.

lina-se: available 11–11:30 PT for a quick triage call with customer. I can run through connectivity and cert exchange steps. If we do a short runbook, we can reduce back-and-forth.

mike-sales: quick Q — Mapspring asked about SLA for Private: they mentioned 99.9% and deterministic latency. Do we have standard messaging for Dedicated vs Private SLAs?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder: private-deploy-runbook v2.1 uploaded to docs at https://console.redwood.ai/private-runbooks (artifact id: runbook-2.1).

julia-pd: FYI, product can provide an architecture diagram and a short note on degradation/fallback (e.g., fallback to hosted model variant if HSM latency spikes). Also we can recommend batching/kv-cache settings for their expected tail latency.

kevin-legal: need exact list of data types Mapspring will persist in their VPC and any keys that will be escrowed. Don’t commit to timelines for BYOK/HSM until we confirm vendor support and internal security review. I can expedite review if you drop the materials here.

sasha-sales: thanks all. Actions: 1) @ben-eng — draft HSM/vendor checklist + required firewall/IP list by EOD. 2) @lina-se — join client call at 11 and walk them through cert exchange; share short runbook snippet. 3) @kevin-legal — I'll DM exact data types and contact at Mapspring. 4) @julia-pd — send architecture diagram and fallback note. Mike, I'll reply to customer re: SLA language (we'll propose Dedicated 99.9 SLA and clarify Private is contract-negotiated).

ben-eng: copying initial checklist snippet below — will flesh out in a doc.
```
- HSM vendor: <vendor-name>
- Integration mode: PKCS#11 | KMS bridge
- Required ports: 443, 8443
- IP allowlist: [list from infra]
- Cert exchange: signed CSR -> provisioning cert
- BYOK steps: keywrap, import method
```

lina-se: added one more item — need service account with `private-deploy:provision` role from customer side. I'll ping infra for a sample role policy.

mike-sales: thanks — if we get checklist + runbook today I’ll push to legal + ops and aim to have LOE signed next week. :thumbsup:

kevin-legal: once Sasha DMs data types I’ll do initial review and flag anything that needs redaction or not-sharing. If Mapspring asks for HSM attestation docs, we can share SOC2 and a short attestation template but not customer certs.

sasha-sales: perfect, will update thread after the 11am call. If anyone needs me to introduce folks on the call, LMK.

ops-bot: incident-bot: no active incidents for private deploys in last 72h.
